tools.name: list_voices_and_styles
tools.description: Return all 8 AvatarSay visual styles, all 8 built-in English TTS voices (with audio sample URLs), per-action credit costs (including first free 5s talking clip and 2-credit NPC voice lines), and one-time credit pack pricing. Public read-only tool — does not require an API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_voices_and_styles, get_credits, list_avatars, list_videos, generate_avatars, create_talking_video, get_job · Private data: list_voices_and_styles, roll_rpg_npc · Public sink: get_credits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_voices_and_styles, get_credits, list_avatars, list_videos, generate_avatars, create_talking_video, get_job · Private data: list_voices_and_styles, roll_rpg_npc · Public sink: get_credits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
